verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents metadata-style filtering via entity-scoped memory (user/agent/app/session) and an explicit reranking feature ('Advanced Retrieval' reorders results by semantic relevance), giving developers real levers beyond plain similarity search. However, there is no documented keyword or hybrid search mode, and reranking details (algorithm, configurability) are thin. Missing for 10: explicit keyword/hybrid search mode, deeper reranking configuration docs, and independent verification that filters/reranking work as advertised.
